prompt: Create one polished 4:3 Location Sheet for the Constantinople sea walls as a single finished production reference board for siege shot planning, not a poster. Make the largest panel a siege-facing establishing view from the Ottoman field toward the wall massing. Add supporting panels for a reverse field-to-wall angle, a high-angle wall/field/city layout read, gate and breach landmarks, weathered stone and repaired masonry swatches, human and siege-equipment scale references, smoke and golden-hour lighting studies, and environmental props such as earthworks, ladders, cannon gear, tents, and debris. Keep every panel consistent with the same 1453 location, materials, palette, field direction, city-edge depth, and selected Movie Lookbook texture and lighting behavior. Keep any labels small and outside important visual content. Exclude modern roads, electrical wires, signage, vehicles, glass curtain walls, industrial streetlights, debug overlays, crop marks, UI, and decorative poster typography.
description: Siege-facing sea-wall board with field approach, reverse geography, wall/city layout, gate damage, stone materials, scale, lighting, and siege props.
title: Sea walls Location Sheet
